verdict.rationale: Copilot's privacy FAQ says users can delete individual conversations or their entire conversation history at any time, which covers the core of deletion control. It also offers an opt-out from using conversation activity for model training, giving some control over how retained data is used. Missing for 10: documented retention-period or auto-delete settings, an explicit way to view and delete stored memory facts, any statement of how long data persists after deletion, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
